This is the first application under Section 438 of the Cr.P.C filed by the applicants who are apprehending their arrest in connection with Crime No.163/2023 registered at Police Station - Kohefiza, District Bhopal for the offences punishable under Sections 419, 420, 467, 468, 471 &
120-B of IPC.
2. Applicants are apprehending their arrest on the basis of registration of offences referred above.

sentences.text: It is submitted by the learned counsel for the applicants that they applied for partition of their ancestral agricultural land over which Tehsildar initiated the proceedings and partition order was passed.
In pursuance thereof, demarcation proceedings were held.
It is the allegations of complainant that in demarcation proceedings, he did not receive notice but documents indicate that he received notice and due endorsement is made available.
Another allegation is that in demarcation proceedings, his area of ownership of land is being compromised.
Learned counsel for the applicants inform this Court that they have not annexed or taken any extra land specially from the ownership of complainant.
They were standing on their own land.
Confinement may bring social disrepute and personal inconvenience.
Applicants undertake to cooperate in the investigation/trial and to make themselves available as and when required.
Under these grounds, counsel prayed for grant of anticipatory bail to the applicants.
4. Learned Government Advocate for the State opposed the prayer and prayed for dismissal of this bail application.
However, he fairly submits that it is the duty of revenue authorities to ensure that demarcation proceedings be held in correct perspective and land of complainant be not compromised in any manner.
5. Learned counsel for the complainant opposed the prayer however, fairly submits that complainant is mainly concerned with his land and its area.

6. Heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the case diary.
7.

Considering the submissions and the peculiar fact situation wherein applicants entered into demarcation proceedings in consequence to partition held between them and, therefore, this Court intends to allow the application.

It is hereby directed that in the event of arrest, the applicants shall be released on bail on their furnishing personal bond of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand Only)
each with one solvent surety each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the Arresting Authority/trial Court.
